signmirrors.config.title: Sign Mirrors
signmirrors.config.enabled.tooltip: Turn every [Mirror] sign back into a plain sign.
signmirrors.config.preset.tooltip: Sets the Quality and Performance options together.
signmirrors.config.preset.note: Choosing a preset sets the Quality and Performance pages. Changing any of those settings yourself switches the preset to Custom.
signmirrors.config.minResolution.tooltip: Reflection size used for small or distant mirrors.
signmirrors.config.maxResolution.tooltip: Reflection size used when a mirror fills the view. The single biggest quality setting.
signmirrors.config.resolutionScale.toolt: How sharp reflections are relative to the screen. 100% gives roughly one reflection texel per screen pixel; mirrors you look at closely get more detail.
signmirrors.config.recursiveMirrors.tool: Show other mirrors inside reflections (one frame behind).
signmirrors.config.maxActiveMirrors.tool: Only this many of the most important visible mirrors are kept up to date.
signmirrors.config.maxMirrorDistance.too: Beyond this, mirrors show as plain signs.
signmirrors.config.frustumCulling.toolti: Don't update or draw mirrors that are off-screen.
signmirrors.config.occlusionCulling.tool: Don't update or draw mirrors that are completely behind blocks or other mirrors.
signmirrors.config.occlusionCheckInterva: Frames between visibility raycasts for each mirror. Lower reacts faster; higher is cheaper.
signmirrors.config.visibilityGraceFrames: Frames a mirror keeps being drawn after it was last seen, to avoid popping.
signmirrors.config.flipFaceV.tooltip: Only needed if reflections appear upside down on your graphics backend.
signmirrors.config.editorGui: Mirror controls in the sign editor
signmirrors.config.editorGui.tooltip: Show the mirror placement and appearance panels when editing the front of a sign.
signmirrors.config.rendersPerFrame.toolt: World renders spent on reflections each frame (one per mirror), shared out by priority: bigger, closer, more central mirrors first. The main performance cost.
signmirrors.editor.make.tooltip: Turn this sign into a mirror. You can change everything about it here.
signmirrors.editor.keep_ratio.tooltip: Keep width and height in proportion while resizing.
signmirrors.editor.reset_angles.tooltip: Clear the offset and all angles.
signmirrors.editor.legacy.tooltip: This sign uses the original text format. It keeps working; your first change here rewrites it in the new format.
signmirrors.editor.pixels.tooltip: Pixelate the reflection into this many sharp pixels per block. 0 = smooth.
signmirrors.editor.tint.tooltip: Colour multiplied into the reflection, as RRGGBB hex. FFFFFF = none.
signmirrors.editor.reflectivity.tooltip: 0 shows just the tint colour; 100 a full reflection.
signmirrors.editor.sign.tooltip: Hide the sign board and text, leaving only the mirror (and its frame).
signmirrors.editor.remove.tooltip: Clear the sign text, making this a plain sign again.
signmirrors.editor.too_long.tooltip: These settings don't fit in this sign's text (hanging signs have short lines). Reset something to its default.
signmirrors.config.irisReflections.toolt: With an Iris shader pack on, render reflections with the pack (each is a full shader-pack render, in a separate pipeline so your own view isn't disturbed). Off: mirrors show only their tint colour while a pack is on.
signmirrors.config.irisRendersPerFrame.t: Used instead of the normal setting while a shader pack is on. Each render runs the whole pack, shadows included, so keep this low.
signmirrors.config.irisResolution.toolti: While a shader pack is on, every reflection uses this one size (so the pack's buffers are never resized).
